title: Telecommand acceptance criteria
body: Every telecommand must pass three independent checks before execution: (1) frame integrity (CRC/checksum), (2) authentication (HMAC or signed envelope), and (3) sequence-number monotonicity. Missing any one check shall cause command rejection with NACK reason recorded.
citation: ECSS-E-ST-50-04C Space Engineering: Telecommand Protocols Synchronization §5.4

title: Telemetry packet structure
body: PUS (Packet Utilisation Standard) packets shall follow the CCSDS 7-octet primary header + secondary header conventions. Service Type 1 (telecommand verification), Service Type 3 (housekeeping), Service Type 5 (event reporting) are mandatory for any flight system claiming PUS compliance.
citation: ECSS-E-ST-70-41C Telemetry and Telecommand Packet Utilization §6

title: Single-event-effect mitigation
body: Components in radiation environment shall implement at least one of: (a) hardware EDAC (Hamming or Reed-Solomon), (b) memory scrubbing on a defined cadence, (c) majority voting (TMR), (d) periodic processor reboot. Single-string non-mitigated SRAM is forbidden in safety-critical paths.

title: Structural design factor of safety
body: Spacecraft primary structure shall meet ultimate factor of safety ≥ 1.4× design limit load (manned 2.0×). Yield FoS ≥ 1.0×. Margin of safety must be reported in the structural verification document for every load case.

title: Thermal margin requirement
body: Active thermal control systems shall maintain components within their qualification temperature range with a margin of at least ±10 °C against worst-case hot/cold steady-state. Transient excursions must remain within absolute survival range.

title: Electrical bus regulation
body: Primary regulated power bus voltage shall remain within ±2 % of nominal under all defined load profiles, including peak transient loads of 200 % nominal for 100 ms. Out-of-range > 50 ms shall trigger autonomous load shed.
